recipe.variant: SDXL 1.0 base inpaint: LoadImage (mask from alpha) -> VAEEncodeForInpaint -> KSampler denoise 1, 25 steps, cfg 7, dpmpp_2m/karras
recipe.from_template: generic ComfyUI inpaint pattern (docs.comfy.org 'Inpainting' / ComfyUI_examples inpaint: VAEEncodeForInpaint(pixels, vae, mask, grow_mask_by)) on the image_sdxl_simple spine; no SDXL inpaint template exists
recipe.confidence: official pattern (docs) + official template settings; not a shipped SDXL graph

grow_mask_by.note: node default 6 px; widens the repainted area

clip_skip.note: CLIP layers to skip, as ComfyUI's stop_at_clip_layer: -1 = none (default); -2 = A1111 / Civitai 'Clip skip: 2', which Pony, Illustrious and most anime fine-tunes are made with

image.note: an RGBA image whose alpha is the mask (Mask Editor / upstream stage): LoadImage output 1 (MASK) feeds the encoder

recipe.defaults_note: 'It also works with non inpainting models' (ComfyUI_examples). Alternatives in the docs: SetLatentNoiseMask on a VAEEncode latent for partial denoise; InpaintModelConditioning for inpaint-trained checkpoints; ImagePadForOutpaint in front for outpainting; ControlNet Union ProMax adds 'repaint'/'tile' types.

vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND (Stability publishes no ComfyUI VRAM figure for SDXL; the fp16 base is 6.94 GB on disk)
